description: This file defines a React functional component named FilterPanel that provides UI controls for filtering dashboard analytics based on date range and poll type. It manages internal state for user inputs and invokes an external callback on form submission.

methods.name: FilterPanel({ onFilter })
methods.description: React functional component rendering a filter form with date range and poll type selection. Handles form submission to invoke the onFilter callback with selected parameters.

methods.name: handleSubmit(e)
methods.description: Event handler for form submission that prevents default behavior and calls onFilter with current filter state.
